sections.title: Couch to 5K
sections.description: A 9-week plan that takes you from no running to 30 minutes non-stop. Three runs a week, each with a 5-minute warm-up walk and a 5-minute cool-down walk. Add one week at a time; each becomes a weekly plan with runs on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Repeat any week whenever you need to.

credit.text: Based on the NHS Couch to 5K plan

items.title: Week 1
items.summary: Run 1 min, walk 1½ min ×7, then a final 1-min run

items.title: Week 2
items.summary: Run 1½ min, walk 2 min ×5, then a final 1½-min run

items.title: Week 3
items.summary: Runs of 1½ and 3 minutes with walks between

items.title: Week 4
items.summary: Runs of 3 and 5 minutes with walks between

items.title: Week 5
items.summary: Three different runs, ending with 20 minutes non-stop

items.title: Week 6
items.summary: Three different runs, ending with 25 minutes non-stop

items.title: Tabata — 4 minutes
items.summary: 20 s all-out, 10 s rest ×8, with a short warm-up

items.title: HIIT — 20 minutes
items.summary: 40 s on, 20 s off ×15 between a warm-up and cool-down

items.title: EMOM — 10 minutes
items.summary: Every minute on the minute: 10 rounds of 1 minute
